common.tagline: ISO 19650 BIM protocols you can actually enforce
common.name: Name

home.title: The BIM protocol as data, not as a document
home.subtitle: Write the protocol once in Spanish, English and Portuguese, and turn it into rules that Revit and IFC can check.
home.feature1Body: Draft, review, approval and supersession, with diffs between versions and a record of who approved what.
home.feature2Body: Define the convention field by field; the system derives the rule, validates live and explains which segment fails.
home.feature3Body: Not just the interface: protocol content is stored per language and exported in the language you choose.
